senses.gloss:
Auṇādikapadārṇava
gr. lex. metrical work in 5 pādas on Uṇādi words an. their derivatives, by Perusūri, son of Veṅkaṭeśvara an. Veṅkaṭeśvarī, pupil of Vāsudevādhvarin an. descendant of Śrīdhara.
Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 14. MD. 1526. 15670. (both inc.). MT. 5551 (inc.). See also Uṇādikośa of Mahādeva Vedāntin, Mad. Uni. Skt. Ser. 21, Foreword, p.. 3-4 an. Intro. p.. xiv-xv.
Ed.. Mad. Uni. Skt. Ser. 7. 1939.

Auṇādikavṛtti
ref. to in a. a.. C. on the Amarakośa. See JOR. Madras, VI. p. 248.
